notes: The best gap analysis of the old arm. The 'Known gaps' section in architecture.md is concrete: invisible due time, no CLI tests, and replay crashing on an orphan assigned/closed event. But the unknown-priority crash appears only in architecture.md, not in the CLI spec. cli.md never says what an unknown priority does on the command line.
The 'test name conflict' (architecture.md:120-122) is a stretch. test_assign_requires_open_ticket only checks that a closed ticket rejects assignment, so it does not conflict with reassignment.
INV-005 'Specs lead the code' is a process rule filed as a system invariant.
Spec format is restated in docs/README.md and product-specs/README.md, and the layering claim appears in both AGENTS.md:40 and architecture.md:31.
